newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets 2 rounds of specials at 4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets 2 rounds of specials at 4 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Tuesday conducted two rounds of special purchase and resale agreements at 4.0 percent in the money market, traders said.
They said the central bank intervened after the call loan or overnight lending rate traded at the top of the bank's 3.5-4.0 percent target range.
"He's just coming in and providing a little bit of help," said one trader. "I wouldn't read anything else into it."
The dealer said the call loan rate has likely traded to the top of the target range on technical pressures and there are no policy implications in the intervention by the Bank.
The call loan rate continued to trade at 4.0 percent following the two rounds of specials, the dealer said.
